messages:
oliver: Taking the evening shift (~18:30 PT). Leaving a short watchlist — no active incident but a few flaky signals to keep on radar. TL;DR: encoder-pool CPU spikes in eu, kv-prefetch tail latency bump in us-west, occasional routing flaps under autoscale.

oliver: Known items:
- encoder-pool: intermittent CPU spikes since 15:10 deploy, shows up as p95/p99 latency and some 522s from encoder-proxy. Runbook note: restart encoder-worker if >3 nodes at >85% CPU for 5m.
- kv-prefetch: p95 tail latency increase for prefix cache in us-west. Quick query: `avg_over_time(prefetch_latency_p95[10m]) > 120` — dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/ABC/prefetch
- eu-routing: small number of 429/reroute errors during autoscale bursts; configured fallback to small-model_variant.

oliver: Actions I already took: rolled back encoder-proxy canary to v1.3.2, opened PR to increase liveness probe, filed ticket INF-321 with collected logs.

marta: Thanks — saw encoder spikes line up with internal-loadtest jobs using batch_size=32. I'll throttle test runner to 16 for tonight to reduce noise.

ash: Noted. ash: Can we suppress `encoder_cpu_spike` alerts in eu for 30m while rollback settles? /me schedules suppression

oncall-bot: Alert suppression scheduled by ash for `encoder_cpu_spike` (30m). Reason: noisy during canary rollback. :white_check_mark:

ryan: Quick operational checks — if you need to restart encoders use: `tools/restart-encoder.sh --region eu --confirm`. Before restarting, check for disk pressure and recent evictions: `kubectl get events -n inference --field-selector reason=Evicted`. Do not restart >2 nodes at once. :thumbsup:

oliver: Copy that. I'll watch dashboards every 10m and DM if anything degrades to P1. Leaving handoff notes on the ticket.

marta: I'll take morning coverage. Confirming ticket INF-321?

oliver: Yup INF-321, added logs and timeline: https://issues.redwood.dev/INF-321 

ash: FYI I'm going to draft a small alert tweak for kv-prefetch (fingerprint noise) and post it to #eng-sre in ~30m for review.

ryan: If kv-prefetch p95 stays >120ms for 20m, escalate to oncall-sre. Otherwise keep as watchlist. Also watch for encoder eviction events (see command above).

marta: :eyes: reminder — if suppression expires and spikes persist, either reapply suppression or flip to manual scaling for affected pool.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled backup of inference-config at 23:00 PT — will not affect running pods.

oliver: End of handoff — signing off in channel. I'll be around by DM for the next 30m for context.
